title: COPE Health Scholars Junior Health Scholar Program (Hospital Clinical Care)
description: Hands-on clinical patient care and hospital volunteering alongside nurses and physicians at partner hospitals across Southern California (including Orange County & LA).

title: CHOC (Children's Hospital of Orange County) High School Volunteer & Medical Intelligence (MI3)
description: Hospital volunteering and the Medical Intelligence and Innovation Institute (MI3) summer internship exploring pediatric medicine and healthcare innovation at CHOC.

title: Hoag Hospital High School Volunteer Program (Newport Beach & Irvine)
description: Clinical support, patient escort, and hospital department volunteering for high school students aged 15+ at Hoag Memorial Hospital Presbyterian.

title: City of Hope Eugene and Ruth Roberts Summer Student Academy
description: 10-week full-time biomedical and cancer research internship at City of Hope (Duarte, CA) where high school students design and execute their own lab research project.

title: Stanford Institutes of Medicine Summer Research Program (SIMR)
description: 8-week biomedical research internship at Stanford University School of Medicine across immunology, neurobiology, cancer biology, and bioengineering.

title: Stanford Clinical Summer Internship (CSI)
description: 2-week interactive clinical medicine and physician shadowing curriculum led by Stanford Medicine physicians featuring virtual patient rounds and surgical skills.

title: NIH High School Summer Internship Program (HS-SIP)
description: 8-week paid biomedical, clinical, and behavioral health research internship inside National Institutes of Health (NIH) laboratories.

title: Cedars-Sinai Minors in Research & Teen Volunteer Program (Los Angeles)
description: Hospital clinical volunteering and biomedical laboratory research placements for high school students at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center.

title: USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center & Keck Medical Youth Programs
description: Summer cancer research and clinical health career pathways at USC Keck School of Medicine for Los Angeles-area high school students.

title: Johns Hopkins Internship in Brain Sciences (JHIBS)
description: Neurology research and clinical shadowing experience with Johns Hopkins neurologists and neuroscientists.

title: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center HOPP Summer Student Program
description: 8-week biomedical and translational oncology research internship working directly with MSKCC scientists.

title: Fred Hutch Cancer Center Summer High School Internship Program (SHIP)
description: 8-week full-time paid biomedical research internship in Seattle for rising high school seniors from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Jackson Laboratory Summer Student Program (Genetics & Genomics)
description: 10-week residential genetics and biomedical research fellowship for graduating high school seniors.

title: Kaiser Permanente LAUNCH High School Summer Youth Employment
description: Paid summer hospital and healthcare administration/clinical operations internship at Kaiser Permanente medical centers.

title: UCSD Health Teen Volunteer Program (La Jolla & Hillcrest)
description: Hospital patient support, clinical unit assistance, and healthcare career exposure at UC San Diego Health.

title: UCLA Health High School Volunteer Program
description: Hospital volunteering across inpatient units, outpatient clinics, and patient transport at Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center and Santa Monica.

title: UCI Health High School Volunteer & Clinical Observation Program
description: Clinical support and hospital volunteering at UCI Medical Center in Orange, California for high school students.

title: Mass General Hospital (MGH) Youth Scholars & Summer Research
description: Hospital clinical shadowing, STEM labs, and healthcare career mentorship at Massachusetts General Hospital.

title: Mayo Clinic SPARK Research Mentorship Program
description: Mentored biomedical laboratory research experience at Mayo Clinic for high school juniors and seniors.

title: American Red Cross High School Volunteer & Blood Services Program
description: Clinical donor support, first aid/CPR leadership, and hospital/blood drive volunteering for high school students nationwide.
